title: Relay error
description: Every non-2xx response of a native route (README section 4.6). The set of codes is closed; a client that meets an unknown code treats it by HTTP status. `message` is one sentence safe to show a person, at most 200 characters, never a stack trace, a credential or an internal path. `retryAfter` and the Retry-After header appear on 429 and 503.

message.description: One sentence, safe to show a person.
